title: NetraniVerdict
description: Deterministic triage verdict emitted by Netrani after three-tier issue verification.

status.description: Canonical triage outcome. VALID means the defect is real and unresolved. DUPLICATE means an identical root-cause issue is already tracked. OBSOLETE means the defect was fixed in a prior commit. FALSE_POSITIVE means code inspection proves the failure mode cannot occur.

citation.description: Evidence citation. For VALID: reproduction trace or file:line path. For DUPLICATE: issue/PR URL. For OBSOLETE: full commit SHA. For FALSE_POSITIVE: file path and line number range proving impossibility.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of the verdict, summarising findings from all three verification tiers.

confidence.description: Confidence score for the verdict, expressed as a float between 0.0 (no confidence) and 1.0 (certainty).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the verdict was recorded (e.g. 2025-01-15T14:32:00Z).

target_repo.description: Repository identifier being triaged (e.g. owner/repo or full remote URL).

issue_reference.description: The issue, ticket, or bug report being triaged (e.g. GitHub issue URL, JIRA ticket ID, or free-form identifier).
